name: @worksbien/check-printer-windows-host
description: Windows desktop host for the locked WorksBien Check Printer engine
author: WorksBien Studios Inc.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.bridge:publish:x64: dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o resources/store-bridge/x64 src/product/store-bridge/WorksBien.StoreBridge.csproj
scripts.bridge:publish:arm64: dotnet publish -c Release -r win-arm64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o resources/store-bridge/arm64 src/product/store-bridge/WorksBien.StoreBridge.csproj
scripts.package:msix:x64: npm run bridge:publish:x64 && npm run manifest:x64 && cross-env MSIX_ARCH=x64 electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.package:msix:arm64: npm run bridge:publish:arm64 && npm run manifest:arm64 && cross-env MSIX_ARCH=arm64 electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=arm64
scripts.package:msix: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run package:msix:x64 && npm run package:msix:arm64
